```{=html}
<style>
.w052-dd { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.9rem; }
.w052-dd .w052-pool {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; min-height: 44px;
  padding: 8px; border-radius: 6px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ccc); margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}
.w052-dd .w052-buckets { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
.w052-dd .w052-bucket {
  flex: 1 1 250px; min-width: 250px; padding: 8px;
  border: 2px dashed var(--bs-border-color, #999); border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); cursor: pointer;
}
.w052-dd .w052-bucket.w052-armed { border-color: #d81e2e; }
.w052-dd .w052-btitle { text-align: center; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.w052-dd .w052-slot { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; min-height: 40px; }
.w052-dd .w052-chip {
  padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: grab; user-select: none;
  border: 1.5px solid #d81e2e; color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); font-weight: 600; text-align: center;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}
.w052-dd .w052-chip.w052-picked { outline: 3px solid #d81e2e; outline-offset: 2px; }
.w052-dd .w052-chip.w052-right { border: 2px solid #2e7d32; }
.w052-dd .w052-chip.w052-wrong { border: 2px solid #d81e2e; }
.w052-dd .w052-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w052-dd button {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w052-dd .w052-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w052-dd .w052-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w052-dd .w052-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
.w052-dd .w052-note { font-size: 0.78rem; font-style: italic; opacity: 0.7; }
.w052-dd .w052-expl { font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.85; border-left: 3px solid #2e7d32; padding: 6px 10px; margin-top: 8px; }
</style>
<div class="w052-dd iw" id="w052-dd">
  <div class="w052-pool" aria-label="cards to sort"></div>
  <div class="w052-buckets">
    <div class="w052-bucket" data-bucket="ls"><div class="w052-btitle">Lift-and-shift (rehost)</div><div class="w052-slot"></div></div>
    <div class="w052-bucket" data-bucket="cn"><div class="w052-btitle">Cloud-native (re-architect)</div><div class="w052-slot"></div></div>
  </div>
  <div class="w052-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w052-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w052-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w052-solution iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w052-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w052-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
  <div class="w052-expl iw-expl" hidden>
    Lift-and-shift (rehosting) moves the application with as little change as possible, so it stays a long-running instance maintained by hand &mdash; fast and low-risk to perform, because nothing changes and nothing breaks. Cloud-native re-architecting rebuilds it around interchangeable, ephemeral and immutable instances that are replaced rather than repaired, and it is the only path on which security can be designed in from the start &mdash; see <a href="#sec-05-two-ways-into-the-cloud">the section on the two ways into the cloud</a> and <a href="#def-immutable">the definition of ephemeral and immutable workloads</a>.
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w052-dd');
  const pool = root.querySelector('.w052-pool');
  const buckets = [...root.querySelectorAll('.w052-bucket')];
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w052-msg');
  const expl = root.querySelector('.w052-expl');
  const ITEMS = [{"t": "Moves the application with as little change as possible", "a": "ls"}, {"t": "Ephemeral, immutable workloads — instances are replaced, not repaired", "a": "cn"}, {"t": "Long-running instances, maintained by hand and patched in place", "a": "ls"}, {"t": "Rebuilds the application around interchangeable instances and managed services", "a": "cn"}, {"t": "Fast and low-risk to perform: nothing changes, so nothing breaks", "a": "ls"}, {"t": "The only path on which security can be designed in from the start", "a": "cn"}];
  let picked = null;

  function chips() { return [...root.querySelectorAll('.w052-chip')]; }
  function unpick() {
    if (picked) picked.classList.remove('w052-picked');
    picked = null;
    buckets.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('w052-armed'));
  }
  function clearMarks() {
    chips().forEach(c => c.classList.remove('w052-right', 'w052-wrong'));
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w052-msg iw-msg';
  }
  function place(bucket, chip) {
    bucket.querySelector('.w052-slot').appendChild(chip);
    clearMarks();
  }
  function makeChip(item, i) {
    const c = document.createElement('div');
    c.className = 'w052-chip';
    c.textContent = item.t;
    c.dataset.key = String(i);
    c.dataset.answer = item.a;
    c.draggable = true;
    c.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (c.parentElement === pool) {
        if (picked === c) { unpick(); return; }
        unpick(); picked = c; c.classList.add('w052-picked');
        buckets.forEach(b => b.classList.add('w052-armed'));
      } else { pool.appendChild(c); unpick(); clearMarks(); }
    });
    c.addEventListener('dragstart', e => e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', c.dataset.key));
    return c;
  }
  buckets.forEach(bucket => {
    bucket.addEventListener('click', () => { if (picked) { place(bucket, picked); unpick(); } });
    bucket.addEventListener('dragover', e => e.preventDefault());
    bucket.addEventListener('drop', e => {
      e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
      const key = e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain');
      const chip = root.querySelector('.w052-chip[data-key="' + key + '"]');
      if (chip) { place(bucket, chip); unpick(); }
    });
  });
  pool.addEventListener('dragover', e => e.preventDefault());
  pool.addEventListener('drop', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const key = e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain');
    const chip = root.querySelector('.w052-chip[data-key="' + key + '"]');
    if (chip) { pool.appendChild(chip); unpick(); clearMarks(); }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w052-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    let right = 0, wrong = 0;
    chips().forEach(c => {
      c.classList.remove('w052-right', 'w052-wrong');
      const b = c.closest('.w052-bucket');
      if (!b) return;
      if (b.dataset.bucket === c.dataset.answer) { c.classList.add('w052-right'); right++; }
      else { c.classList.add('w052-wrong'); wrong++; }
    });
    const unplaced = ITEMS.length - right - wrong;
    if (right === ITEMS.length) {
      msg.textContent = '\u2713 All correct \u2014 you can tell the two worlds apart.';
      msg.className = 'w052-msg iw-msg ok';
    } else if (wrong === 0) {
      msg.textContent = 'Keep going \u2014 ' + unplaced + ' card(s) still to place.';
      msg.className = 'w052-msg iw-msg';
    } else {
      msg.textContent = '\u2717 Not yet \u2014 the red cards are in the wrong box. Send them back and try again.';
      msg.className = 'w052-msg iw-msg bad';
    }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w052-solution').addEventListener('click', () => {
    unpick();
    chips().forEach(c => {
      const bucket = buckets.find(b => b.dataset.bucket === c.dataset.answer);
      if (bucket) place(bucket, c);
    });
    chips().forEach(c => c.classList.add('w052-right'));
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown — reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.className = 'w052-msg iw-msg ok';
    expl.hidden = false;
  });
  root.querySelector('.w052-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    chips().sort((a, b) => Number(a.dataset.key) - Number(b.dataset.key))
           .forEach(c => pool.appendChild(c));
    unpick(); clearMarks();
    expl.hidden = true;
  });
  ITEMS.forEach((it, i) => pool.appendChild(makeChip(it, i)));
})();
</script>
```
